title: Without Merit
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: Merit Voss lives in a converted church with an eccentric, fractured family, each of whom keeps a secret. She decides it is time to bring the truth out, whatever it costs.
readIf: you want a quirky, character-heavy family story with heart and a bit of romance.
skipIf: you want a pure love story, because the family drama and its heavy themes take centre stage.

pairings.reason: Another honest, tender story about a young person sorting out family secrets and a messy emotional life.
A young romance that grows out of a difficult home life, with a gentle, bittersweet tone.
Shares the theme of a teenager struggling to say what is true, but is far more sombre.
